an6.41:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
an6.41:1.3: atha kho āyasmā sārīputto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto aññatarasmiṃ padese mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ
an6.41:1.5: passatha no āvuso tumhe amuṃ mahantaṃ dārukkhandhanti
an6.41:2.1: ākaṅkhamāno āvuso bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto amuṃ dārukkhandhaṃ paṭhavītveva adhimuceyya
an6.41:2.3: atthi āvuso amusmiṃ dārukkhandhe paṭhavidhātu yaṃ nissāya bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto amuṃ dārukkhandhaṃ paṭhavītveva adhimucceyya.
an6.41:2.4: ākaṅkhamāno āvuso bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto amuṃ dārukkhandhaṃ āpotveva adhimucceyya …pe…
an6.41:2.10: atthi āvuso amusmiṃ dārukkhandhe asubhadhātu yaṃ nissāya bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto amuṃ dārukkhandhaṃ asubhantveva adhimucceyyāta.
